summary: RIO TINTO LTD filed Form 6-K, a routine report of foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16. The filing compiles various standard announcements for April 2026, including total voting rights updates, dividend notifications, share issuance/cancellation notices, PDMR shareholdings, and charitable donations. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is present. This is a periodic compilation of ordinary corporate housekeeping matters.
